scope: All queue_fund repeated episodes and their actual native target/victim histories; absolute observed stalls only

interpretation.repeat_exchange: Frequent victim-to-later-target transitions and reciprocal source pairs are observed; each episode has native admission and first output, while actual victim pauses remain in the raw trajectory.
interpretation.causal_limit: Native and queue-only arms have different scheduling states; no per-episode incremental cost or same-state counterfactual is identified.
interpretation.next_action: Compare this fixed repeated funded policy with the existing ordinary free-fit backfill baseline on the same frozen input, retaining all victim costs and complete-request tails.
